# dokploy_registries (Data Source)

Fetches all container registries from Dokploy. Use this data source to discover registry IDs for importing existing resources.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "dokploy_registries" "all" {}

# Output all registry IDs for import discovery
output "registry_ids" {
  value = { for r in data.dokploy_registries.all.registries : r.name => r.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `registries` (Attributes List) List of all container registries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registries))

<a id="nestedatt--registries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `registries`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the registry.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the registry.
- `image_prefix` (String) The image prefix for the registry.
- `name` (String) The name of the registry.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID the registry belongs to.
- `type` (String) The registry type (selfHosted, docker, github, etc.).
- `url` (String) The registry URL.
- `username` (String) The username for registry authentication.
